Package enemy

package enemy
The enemies: an abstract Enemy and its kinds (bouncer, speeder, spinner, gater).

The package only sees the world through Arena and Obstacle, so it doesn't depend on the rest of the game.

  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    enemy.ability
    The abilities of the player's drop: Ability lists them and the light that teaches each, Dash, Slide and Shoot say what they do, and Shot is the ball the last one fires.
  • Class
    Description
    Arena
    What an enemy can see of the world it moves in.
    Bouncer
    Enemy that crosses the rooms in a straight line at a constant speed and bounces on the walls, on the invisible barriers and on the other bouncers.
    Enemy
    Base class of every enemy: a neon shape that moves in an Arena and kills the drops it touches.
    Gater
    Enemy that closes a corridor in rhythm: two jaws come out of the walls, stay open for 1.6 s, close in 0.35 s, stay shut for 0.9 s and open again in 0.45 s.
    Obstacle
    Something an enemy bounces on: a segment with a thickness, such as a wall or a barrier.
    Speeder
    Enemy that patrols between two stops: it waits 2 s, aims at the other stop, then dashes there at high speed.
    Spinner
    Enemy shaped like a bar that turns around its centre at a constant speed.
